name: Call of Air - Mulverick's Fleet
label: Quest
description: Call of Air - Mulverick's Fleet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I was locked up in a dwarven hellhole for days. You better believe I want revenge!

First, my war riders need targets to gun for - high priority targets. I'm going to need to feed them the flesh of Stormpike Commanders. Unfortunately, those little buggers are entrenched deep behind enemy lines! You've definitely got your work cut out for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not enough! I would expect this level of work from an initiate, but you, friend? Come on, soldier! HUSTLE! More flesh is needed!
